name: LivestockHerdRegister
tagline: Herd and flock register with movements, standstill, deaths, lineage and growth – one drop-in Power Apps control.
description: A complete livestock register app for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages: official tags, breed, sex and age, dam/sire lineage, groups and pens with capacity, moves on and off with holding numbers, standstill rule, report-within flags, deaths with cause and disposal, weigh sessions with ADG and herd KPIs.
features: Demo mode with fictional herd and flock
Undo, CSV export, Power Fx outputs and events
controlType: standard (two controls: LivestockHerdRegister data-set + LivestockHerdRegisterPortal field control, shared src/app)
